The whole suite is the tree `vitest` walks, both packages included, and that gate also refuses a series-shaped title its alternation does not match, so a series joins the pattern when it is opened rather than when somebody remembers. Two id spaces reach the head of a title without declaring a case and are not gated as series: a plan slice id, which carries a digit in its prefix, such as `T4-3`; and an architecture invariant `I-n` from [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md), which several cases may cite for one invariant. See issue #289.

edits.find:
- **Just landed.** The `AE-` series is gated for uniqueness, [issue #283](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/283). Nineteen ids were declared in `apply-ai-edit.test.ts`, cited by `docs/AI-EDIT-WORKFLOW.md` and by the header of the script they cover, and absent from the pattern `evidence-case-ids.test.ts` scans, so nothing would have caught a second `AE-7`. The widening needed a third case to have any evidence at all: the collision case iterates the ids the pattern found, so a series the pattern cannot see is green by construction, which is the silence rather than a weak assertion. It earns no ADR, and the guardrail it earns is the last bullet of `GUARDRAILS.md`: an allowlist is the thing that needs a gate.
- **Landed before it.** This file states current state only and a gate refuses growth, [issue #284](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/284) by [#285](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/285). Three sections that grew once per slice left it: the per-slice narrative and the run ids into the pull requests that already owned them, the standing rules into [GUARDRAILS.md](./GUARDRAILS.md), and what a live edit costs into [LIVE-EDIT-COST.md](./LIVE-EDIT-COST.md), both moves verbatim and in order.
edits.replace:
- **Just landed.** The evidence-id gate refuses a series its pattern cannot see, [issue #289](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/289). Two decisions rather than two widenings. The scan root is the tree `vitest` walks rather than one package's test directory, so `H-4` in `packages/react/test/public-hook-render.test.ts` is in the collision map at all; and an id at the head of a title declares a case unless it belongs to a space this project spends elsewhere, which is a plan slice id carrying a digit in its prefix or an architecture invariant `I-n`. That second half is measured rather than anticipated: the first red run refused eight `I-` ids across five files, three of them declared twice, and reading them is what turned a false refusal into the rule. It earns no ADR: the gate's own header already owns what each series covers.
- **Landed before it.** The `AE-` series is gated for uniqueness, [issue #283](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/283). Nineteen ids were declared in `apply-ai-edit.test.ts`, cited by `docs/AI-EDIT-WORKFLOW.md` and by the header of the script they cover, and absent from the pattern `evidence-case-ids.test.ts` scans, so nothing would have caught a second `AE-7`. It widened the alternation by hand and left the alternation itself ungated, which is the half the slice above finishes, and the guardrail it earned is the last bullet of [GUARDRAILS.md](./GUARDRAILS.md): an allowlist is the thing that needs a gate.

edits.find: - **Make the evidence-id gate refuse what it cannot see.** Two halves, and both are decisions rather than widenings, which is why issue #283 did neither. The pattern is a hand-maintained alternation, so the honest gate finds every `PREFIX-n` title in the tree and refuses a prefix the pattern does not name; a naive scan of that shape reads `T4-n` and `T5-n` as ungated series, and those are the locked plan decisions the `T-` paragraph exists to avoid colliding with, so it needs a stated rule for what is a series and what is a plan id. Separately the scan root stops at `packages/core/test`, and `H-4` is declared in `packages/react/test/public-hook-render.test.ts`, so an id can be duplicated across the two packages without the gate seeing it.
edits.replace: - **Fifteen series paragraphs give a false reason for the order of the alternation.** Each two-letter series in `evidence-case-ids.test.ts` states that it sorts before its own initial because an alternation offering `C` first would match `C` and then fail on the `F`. A backtracking engine retries the next alternative, so `/(?:C|CF)-\d+/` matches `CF-3` and every one of the fifteen orderings is free. Measured against all fifteen pairs while the gate above was written, and deliberately not in it: the ordering the paragraphs ask for is harmless and the reason they give for it is wrong, so the correction is prose in fifteen places and no behaviour.
